study: TFG core-coefficient refit on the pinned 28-ft vessel RAO records

selection.primary_score: Equal-case mean of weighted log metric ratios against the paired TFG baseline; all eight records and every phase seed have equal weight.
selection.gate_penalty: Add 0.025 per additional gate violation relative to the paired baseline case; retain unpenalized physical scores separately.
surface_checks: Boundary contacts including the coarse joint-grid faces
selection.incomplete_or_nonfinite_candidate: Retain evidence and mark ineligible, never treat missing metrics as zero.
selection.holdout_use: Freeze exactly one candidate and its coefficient hash before executing any sealed holdout case. Never select or refine candidates using holdout results.

promotion_checks.additional_validation: The compiled shipping-default candidate must also pass the unchanged deterministic regression suite before promotion.

constraints: Do not repeat the completed generic or attitude/bias campaigns
Do not claim global optimality from a finite search
A failed holdout does not authorize trying another candidate on the same holdout seeds

aggregation_clarification_before_holdout.mean_case_rms: mean(case_RMS), also reported; not mislabeled as a pooled RMS
aggregation_clarification_before_holdout.selection_score: Unchanged equal-case weighted log ratios with the original paired gate penalty.
aggregation_clarification_before_holdout.conservative_promotion_interpretation: Apply the predeclared primary nonregression, record-win and secondary 5 percent guards to both pooled RMS and mean-case RMS. Thresholds are unchanged; no guard is loosened.
aggregation_clarification_before_holdout.timing: Recorded after training/boundary data but before candidate freeze and before any sealed holdout evaluation.
